reset.notApplicable: No reset motion: the intake stays deployed and each lane's feeder stages the next FUEL as the last one leaves, which the hopper cycle trial covers

risks.risk: The flywheel slows under each shot and through a batch, and the release leaves the scoring band
risks.closedBy: Flywheel a free 0.0076 kg m2 body (roller plus one inertia ring, 2.56 kg) under two motors and a speed loop, fed only inside a 1% ready band: one shot takes 17 J and drops the wheel 1.9%; 24 FUEL at 4 FUEL/s release at 6.88-6.92 m/s on a 12 V bus and 6.83-6.88 m/s on the 8.34 V weak-pack bus, inside the 6.725-7.100 m/s band (batch trials)

risks.risk: The model's wheel-to-FUEL speed transfer, drag and spin lift are estimates, so the setpoint that centres the release in the band is not known

benchTest.measure: FUEL scored of 20 launched from the 2.7 m pose, with every measured release speed of a 24 FUEL batch inside the band found on the bench

risks.risk: A staged FUEL is pushed into the spinning flywheel with no feed commanded
risks.closedBy: One braked feeder roller per lane over a fixed lane deck, 14 mm squeeze, floor belt ending ahead of the staged FUEL and stopped while both lanes are staged: the hold trial keeps the FUEL 25.6 mm clear under a 90 N push at 1.5 g and fails at 120 N. In the 16 collect-hold-feed patterns the push on a staged FUEL peaks at 138 N (20 ms mean), above the steady push the hold trial passes, as FUEL land on the heap, and no pattern feeds uncommanded; the bench tests hold-back-force and uncommanded-feed-bench measure the margin

risks.risk: The hold rests on foam friction and stiffness that are estimates (0.9 and 0.6, 15 kN/m)

benchTest.measure: Steady push on a staged FUEL that the braked feeder holds without the FUEL reaching the wheel

risks.risk: The intake belt cannot hold its speed under the acquisition load at its current limit
risks.closedBy: Belt driven in the trial by one motor at 2:1 with a 30 A supply limit: three FUEL abreast on a 9 V bus dip it to 2.13 m/s and are captured; the trial captures down to 2.5 m/s and fails at 2 m/s

risks.risk: Capture depends on the belt squeeze and on cover and back plate friction, which are estimates

benchTest.measure: Floor FUEL thrown over the back plate within 1.2 s, of 20, at 17.5, 20 and 25 mm squeeze with the belt at or above 2.5 m/s

risks.risk: A batch of 24 cannot be collected: thrown in low through an open throat, the hopper stalls with FUEL backing out into the intake
risks.closedBy: The intake is a chute that lifts each FUEL up its own back plate to 425 mm and throws it in over the top; the back plate closes the hopper front. Collect trial: 24 in the hopper and 0 in the chute of 24; collecting 27 leaves more than four in the chute (bracket). The earlier issue's low entry fails the same trial (control)

risks.risk: The collected heap bridges or strands FUEL and the feed falls below 2.00 FUEL/s
risks.closedBy: Two-lane channel with the belt running to the front rail, sloped shelves, feeder rollers standing in the hopper and meeting at the centre line, one stage beam per lane, a belt reversal and a 40 mm carriage nudge in the unjam cycle: 16 of 16 collect-hold-feed patterns feed all 24 in 7.1-10.5 s (2.3-3.4 FUEL/s)

risks.risk: Heap behaviour varies from run to run and rests on FUEL-to-FUEL and wall friction estimates; the slowest pattern feeds 24 in 10.5 s against 12 s

benchTest.measure: FUEL fed to the flywheel within 12 s of the first feed command, 24 collected through the chute, in each of 5 runs

risks.risk: A hard stop can throw FUEL forward over the chute, which is open above the top roller. Harder stops are tested on single patterns only: at 0.75 g 1 of 1 tested patterns keep and feed all 24; at 1 g 2 of 2 tested patterns keep and feed all 24

benchTest.measure: FUEL leaving the robot across ten stops from 3 m/s and five turns at the loaded acceleration limit of 0.5 g with 24 aboard

risks.risk: A FUEL reaches the flywheel while collecting or driving

benchTest.measure: Uncommanded feeds in 20 collect-and-drive cycles of 24 FUEL

risks.risk: The inspection weight estimate tops out 2.20 kg under the 52.16 kg limit

benchTest.measure: Weighed inspection weight of the robot without bumpers and battery

risks.risk: The robot hangs yawed or offset and a bumper misses an upright

benchTest.measure: Least clearance to the carpet and TOWER BASE through the 3 s hold, at 70.3 kg, seated at 0 and at 20 mm lateral offset each way

risks.risk: The intake cannot stow with FUEL in the front of the hopper, and deployed it stands under the rung
risks.closedBy: The hang sequence swings the hooks forward first, then stows the empty intake between them, then closes on the TOWER (cases climb-reach, intake-stow, tower-forward, checked). The stow is commanded only with the chute and both stage beams clear; with FUEL aboard the robot keeps shooting and does not hang, which is the strategy's own rule

risks.risk: The front bumper corner clears the BUMP crest by 8.7 mm in the static screen

benchTest.measure: Least clearance of any part other than wheels and bumpers over the BUMP in ten crossings each way, intake retracted

risks.risk: The battery has no hold-down
risks.closedBy: A strap over the battery top between the two cleats is drawn and mounted, and the shelf panel above it covers it; the service cases remove the panel and strap, then lift the battery (checked)

risks.risk: Members carried no registered joint to the frame
risks.closedBy: Each separately mounted member has its own mount entry: both feeder rollers and motors, both carriage plates, both inner tubes, both hooks, both climber tubes, the winch, the side walls, liners, rear wall, shelf panel and strap

risks.risk: The loaded-transit duty leaves the smallest voltage margin on a weak battery

benchTest.measure: Minimum bus voltage through a loaded transit with the flywheel spinning up, on a battery at 0.026 ohm

risks.risk: The unjam cycle's carriage nudge has to push the back plate into the FUEL at the hopper front. In the recorded trials the pattern run without the nudge also feeds all 24, so the trials do not show the nudge is needed

benchTest.measure: Arches at the hopper front cleared by one 40 mm nudge, of 10 set by hand with 24 FUEL aboard

risks.risk: Driving over the BUMP at speed with stored FUEL is not evaluated

benchTest.measure: FUEL leaving the robot in ten BUMP crossings each way at 1.5 m/s with 24 aboard and the intake retracted

risks.risk: Robot-to-robot contact while carrying FUEL is not evaluated

benchTest.measure: FUEL leaving the robot in five 1 m/s bumper-to-bumper contacts on each side with 24 aboard
